pages.title: Your money, in one place
pages.body: Keep everyday spending and income together, so your financial picture stays clear.

media.accessibilityLabel: Three financial overview cards with charts, a receipt, and coins.

pages.title: Stay close to every transaction
pages.body: Add, search, and filter activity whenever you need to understand where your money went.

media.accessibilityLabel: A calm transaction timeline with income and expense markers and a magnifying glass.

pages.title: Plan with confidence
pages.body: Set category budgets and see your progress before a small expense becomes a surprise.

media.accessibilityLabel: Three organised budget compartments, a progress ring, and a checkmark.

pages.title: Start with one transaction
pages.body: Add an expense or income in less than a minute, then let Personal Finance reveal your progress.

media.accessibilityLabel: An indigo compass chart with a rising teal trend line and a star.

releases.title: A clearer way to explore
releases.summary: Meet the tools that help you understand, plan, and move forward with your money.

items.title: Explore the app
items.body: A fresh guide introduces the essentials when you are new, and remains available whenever you want a refresher.

media.accessibilityLabel: Three financial overview cards with charts, a receipt, and coins.

releases.title: Financial Pulse is here
releases.summary: Build a daily money habit and keep your weekly spending room close at hand.

items.title: A daily money check-in
items.body: The new Financial Pulse helps you log your day, confirm a no-spend day, and build a calm check-in streak.

media.accessibilityLabel: A glass financial card with an indigo pulse line, checkmark, and daily check-in ring.

items.title: Safe to spend, at a glance
items.body: Add the new Home Screen widget to see your daily spending room and open Insights when you need the full picture.

media.accessibilityLabel: A floating glass widget with a teal and indigo spending gauge, seven day markers, and coins.
